                                   JOINT STATUS REPORT

       In accordance with State Office of Administrative Hearings Order No. 11, Southwestern

Electric Power Company (SWEPCO) respectfully submits this joint status report regarding the

settlement in principle reached by the parties. The parties continue to work to finalize the

settlement provisions and propose to file either a settlement agreement or status report on or before

September 16, 2026.
